recommendation: Resolve all three findings and re-review exact revised bytes before WBS build.

findings.claim: Genesis accounting records each side-effecting activity only once with its result, so no durable pre-effect authorization proves or debits a call or file effect when the process crashes after that effect but before the single RootControlJournal append.
findings.disposition_reason: Confirmed genesis activity accounting lacks pre-effect authorization/outcome pairing.

findings.claim: ReviewRouteAuthorizationAmendment does not require its HUMAN actor to equal the designated mission decision owner or resolve through a complete owner-rooted, non-revoked, exact-scope delegation chain, although the amendment changes the review route and adds review-call budget for an acceptance prerequisite.
findings.disposition_reason: Confirmed route-amendment authority is not explicitly rooted in the mission decision owner.

findings.claim: The REVIEW_PENDING amendment path can add route and call budget after the immutable policy's single typed retry is exhausted, but it neither versions that retry policy nor defines a global amendment/retry ceiling, so the same policy hash can authorize more calls than its stated maximum.

locator.value: §12 Reviewer availability and fallback, step 5 and REVIEW_PENDING paragraph

findings.disposition_reason: Confirmed route amendment may exceed immutable retry/call ceilings.

residual_risks: Genesis crash accounting and review-amendment authority/budget closure remain incomplete.
